class.name: VoxelEdit
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for edits to 4D voxel data.
class.description: A VoxelEdit produces the voxel content of one edited region to write into a [VoxelData] volume. It works exactly like the [VoxelGenerator] it is, except that it only covers the region inside its bounds rather than a whole world. Each subclass represents one shape of edit, configured by the parameters it is instantiated with. Edits are applied with [method VoxelWorld4D.apply_edit]. New edit shapes can currently only be implemented in C++.
